scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: The Peter Goldmark Files document the administrative and programmatic activities of the Rockefeller Foundation during Peter C. Goldmark Jr.'s tenure as President. The collection primarily consists of internal and external correspondence and memos that illustrate the Foundation's strategic direction and day-to-day operations during the late 1980s and 1990s. The records include significant documentation regarding the Global Environment Program, HIV/AIDS prevention, equal opportunity, school reform, as well as international security programs.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: The collection was intellectually organized into functional series based largely on the original order. Most of the records were arranged by year or function area. Physical folders remain in their original order as received.

acqinfo.head: Immediate Source of Acquisition
acqinfo.p: The Rockefeller Foundation records, President's Office, Peter Goldmark Files were donated to RAC in 2023.

userestrict.head: Conditions Governing Use
userestrict.p: Rockefeller Foundation has title, copyright, and literary rights in the collection, in so far as it holds them. Rockefeller Archive Center has authority to grant permission to cite and publish archival material from the collection.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: This series contains correspondence, memoranda, and related documentation between the Rockefeller Foundation President's Office and various members of the Board of Trustees. Most of the files contain correspondence with former trustees.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: This series documents the high-level administration functions of the Rockefeller Foundation. It includes information about the board and committee governance, personnel and leadership (including the appointment of Peter Goldmark as President), organizational transitions, and special initatives.
